entities.text: Yasaram Kalavathi vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking to declare the action of the respondent Nos.3 and 4 in interfering with the petitioner's constitutional rights and trying to dispossess him from the property in Plot No.154 in Sy.No.40 admeasuring 400 sq. yards or 334.45 sqm. situated at Bandalguda Village,
Uppal Mandal, Medchal Malkajgiri District, without initiating the land acquisition proceedings as illegal and arbitrary.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri M. Durga Prasad, learned Standing Counsel for GHMC.
3.

Learned Standing Counsel for GHMC, on instructions, submits that the respondent authorities are not interfering with the petitioner's property and they are taking steps to demolish the encroachments in the road margin and as such, there is no cause of SK, J action in the present writ petition and requested to dismiss the writ petition.
4.

In view of the submission of the learned Standing Counsel, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the petitioner's property in Plot No.154 in Sy.No.40 admeasuring 400 sq. yards situated at Bandlaguda Village, Uppal Mandal, Medchal Malkajgiri District, without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they shall follow due procedure under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending in this writ petition, shall stand closed.
_ _ _ JUSTICE K.SARATH Date:08.07.2024 sj Smt Yasaram Kalavathi vs The State Of Telangana
